name: za-foreign-employment-exemption
description: South African section 10(1)(o)(ii) foreign employment income exemption for tax residents who render services outside the Republic as employees, for the 2027 year of assessment (1 March 2026 to 28 February 2027) and earlier years from 2021. Covers the day tests that gate the exemption (more than 183 full days and a continuous period of more than 60 full days in any 12-month period), the work-day apportionment, the R1.25 million cap per year of assessment, choosing the 12-month window, counting full days, IRP5 foreign service coding, the ITR12 claim and the section 6quat credit on the taxed balance. Use for questions about working abroad, seconded employees, expatriates still resident in South Africa, touring professionals, the 183 and 60 day tests or the R1.25 million cap.
